cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I pressed zero like you did. Stay for my pumpkin's weight; we're settling our competition today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine was an empty basket. You've zeroed the scales with your pumpkin on them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, starting level. Stay while I lift it off and put it back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reset it while it's empty. I've got to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reset it with me before you go, then stay for the weight. We're not agreeing a winner from memory.

reason: Replace the disconnected confidence prefaces with a specific copied act whose correction changes A's pursuit. Keep the exact Drive motive in the same exchange and give B a practical stake.
